title: N0va Phishkit Targets US and EU Businesses: A New Challenge for Identity Security

title: Threat Intelligence Alone Won't Close the Exploitation Gap
summary: A leaked credential shows up in a criminal marketplace, or a vulnerability gets a disclosure advisory, and either one can be weaponized against a real target before most security teams have triaged the alert. Attackers are combining that kind of intelligence with AI-assisted exploitation to accelerate the path from exposure to breach faster than most security programs are built to react.
